purpose: Original WindowsWidget icon family informed by Microsoft official Windows 11 design references

references.role: official style reference, not a reproduction target
official flat layering and theme contrast reference

icons.prompt: Create ONE original Windows 11 desktop product icon. The attached official Microsoft reference board is ONLY a style reference: study its camera, weather, notebook, shield, folder, clock and phone icons. Do not reproduce the board, text, grid, existing Microsoft products or logos. Art direction: flat front-facing layered graphic illustration, crisp simple silhouette, modest corner rounding (about 2 units in a 48-unit design), predominantly solid colors with very gentle two-tone tonal shading. Use a small soft masked shadow ONLY where one flat shape overlaps another, with NO external cast shadow. Think precise Windows 11 utility icon, with thin planes and calm color, not a 3D render. Absolutely NO glossy plastic, inflated/puffy shapes, glass, reflections, specular highlights, metallic bevels, shiny white rim, neon glow, isometric perspective, pedestal or surrounding scene. No letters, text, numbers, labels, watermark or backplate behind the object. TRUE transparent alpha background. Centered square composition, subject about 78 percent of canvas, clean empty margin, sharply readable at 24 pixels. Keep only one main metaphor and at most one supporting metaphor. Subject: A distinctive modular-widget utility mark: one upright blue rectangular panel with restrained rounded corners and a single smaller cyan panel overlapping its lower right corner. On the large panel, two broad pale-blue horizontal content bars. Both panels are completely flat, facing the viewer, thin layered shapes. Cool Microsoft-like blue and cyan color family. No four-pane Windows logo. Keep the two-panel silhouette compact and immediately recognizable.
